turns.assessment: The decisive evidence is simultaneous OSC_LOS on both directions of fibre span 2 of 3 between S17 and S24 (O95/O96), accompanied by AMP_INPUT_LOS at the next inline amplifiers in both directions (O1/O2). This is the documented signature of both fibres in a cable being cut and explains the simultaneous loss of many optical channels, including the S08–S17 lightpath used by svc357. Unchanged pump currents argue strongly against amplifier pump failures.

proposals.rationale: Both directional representations of the same physical span lost OSC at exactly t=602.5, and the downstream inline amplifiers simultaneously reported input LOS. A cable cut normally severs both fibres and produces precisely these all-channel and OSC losses.

An extreme added loss from a crushed cable or damaged splice could also lose both payload and OSC, but simultaneous complete failure in both directions is substantially more characteristic of a cable cut.
